subject: computer
source: CISCE Curriculum for Primary Classes I-V (2016), official

covers: Know that a computer is an electronic device
Explain the input, process and output (IPO) cycle
Compare the way a computer works with the way a human works
List advantages of computers: speed, storage, automation, calculation and learning
List disadvantages: effects on health and environment, viruses and cybercrime
Practise healthy habits while using a computer
Recall the many uses of computers
Name places where computers help: classroom, office and home
Connect computer use to topics they study in other subjects
Tell input devices (keyboard, mouse) from output devices (printer, monitor)
Explain the function of each input and output device
Know that some output devices, such as CDs and pen drives, also store data
Draw and name common devices
Find the special and punctuation keys and say what they do
Know that some keys work in combination, such as Shift with a letter
Know a key combination such as Ctrl+Alt+Del
Practise the keys through worksheets and computer quizzes
List the activities done with the mouse buttons
Drag and drop objects with the mouse
Switch the left and right buttons when needed
Explain what Paint software is for
Open, minimise, maximise and close the Paint window
Save a file in a chosen place and open an existing file
Draw pictures with the shape tools
Make simple pictures such as birthday cards and posters
Understand that files are documents, pictures or presentations made with software
Know why files need to be organised on a computer
Save a file to a given path
